name: Octree Based Voxel Model
definition: A method to discretize a 3D product assembly and empty spaces into voxels using an octree data structure to represent volumetric space and detect spatial conflicts, avoiding the memory issues of dense 3D arrays.
summary: An octree-based voxel model discretizes 3D space into voxils using an octree to detect conflicts and manage empty space, avoiding dense array memory issues when modeled space is under 30 percent.
